data.name: Mourningwood Lodge:Pray
data.detailed_description:
"Mourningwood Lodge:Pray" is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action mystery horror game. As the third installment in the "Mourningwood Lodge" series, players will delve into an entirely new story, assuming the role of a fresh character to embark on a suspenseful journey. While being the third entry, the plot of this game maintains connections with the previous two installments. Throughout the experience, players must search for clues and piece together evidence to uncover the truth behind the case and reveal hidden events. The ultimate fate of all characters hinges on the player's decisions. With everyone's lives at stake, every choice must be made with caution.

Story Background

Xieling Ridge, a centuries-old town sheltered by the faith of the Three Purities.

The sudden death of the wealthy Merchant Qin is like a stone thrown into deep water, stirring up all the undercurrents. At the funeral, a returned policewoman, a lone girl seeking refuge, a mysterious Taoist priest, a Gu-witch searching for her roots, and an antique dealer with a hidden past—each with their own secrets—gather in the eerie Qin family mansion.

Yet, the ritual of death is far from over. When the steward meets a gruesome end in a locked room, an invisible barrier descends, trapping everyone inside this coffin for the living. No one is innocent; no one can be trusted.

An ancient curse whispers, and behind the legendary Three Purities statues said to grant wishes lurks a more sinister presence. Every person who prays to the idols pays an unforeseen price. Is this a divine trial, or the cruel game of a malevolent force?

Game Features​

Evidence Collection

Players can search the participants of the event and gather clues.

Analysis

Piece together different clues to uncover the truth of the entire story.

Decision-Making

At critical life-and-death moments, players must make the right choices—or risk total annihilation.

Exploration

Venture into different areas to gather various pieces of information.

Judgment

At certain points, players must make their own judgments, with each decision influencing the story's outcome.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes  frequent scenes disturbing and horrific scenes of implied violence, gore and mutilation of human bodies. It may have a realistic triggering impact on players with potential sensitivities. Player discretion is advised.
May not be suitable for all age groups.
